programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.desc: 'S5/E4 - Strife Of The Party'. When Lola learns that Lana is planning their joint birthday, she does everything to stop it./ Lincoln and the Middle School Action News Team solve the mystery of the missing popcorn.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: 'S8/E4 - Weather Or Not'. When Darcy's birthday party falls on the same day as one of Lisa's hero scientist's talks, Lisa sends TODD in her place to the party.

programme.desc: 'S2/E18 - Bring It On'. Trying out for the cheerleading squad, Lay Lay and Sadie add their own twists to the routine, but learn that standing out doesn't always work when trying to fit into a team.

programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Thundercover'. Max and Phoebe bring Chloe on an undercover mission to Secret Shores so she can experience life as a normal kid. When a new supervillain threat emerges, the trio must stay in town longer than they anticipated.

programme.title: Henry Danger
programme.desc: 'S4/E17 - Diamonds Are For Heather'. Kid Danger and Captain Man are called to the Swellview Museum of Stools and Jewels to protect the rare Neal Diamond from being stolen.

programme.title: Henry Danger
programme.desc: 'S4/E18 - Meet Cute Crush'. Henry and Ray try to help Piper carry out a 'meet cute' with a new boy she likes from school.

programme.title: Danger Force

programme.desc: 'S3/E2 - iDo'. After an iCarly fan proposes to his girlfriend live on the web show, the gang gets roped into going to the wedding. But when the bride gets cold feet, Carly must come to the rescue.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: 'S3/E3 - iSell Penny Tees'. The gang goes into business making and selling Penny-Tees. After sales go through the roof, Sam recruits 4th-graders to help make shirts. But Carly, Sam, & Freddie disagree about how to treat them.

programme.title: Victorious
programme.desc: 'S1/E8 - Robarazzi'. Robbie is upset because his blog on The Slap is going to be shut down because it's deemed too boring. Tori suggests that Robbie should capture videos of the students' everyday lives to help increase traffic.

programme.title: Sam & Cat
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - #BabysitterWar'. When a kid they babysit says, 'You're my favorite babysitter ever', Sam and Cat debate which one of them he meant. They compete for their new clients' affection to see who really is the best babysitter.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja...
programme.desc: 'Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles. S1/E6 - Night Of The Mechazoids'. The Turtles take the fight to Bishop but she's ready for them... get ready for MECHA-BIHSOP!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: 'S16/E9 - Stupor-stition'. Squidward is lost in a garbage jungle. // Plankton gets trapped while undercover.
